name: Chef Jessen
summary: In Southshore, Chef Jessen works to feed the town amid constant border tensions. He is best known for his famous turtle bisque.

sections.title: A Cook in Southshore
sections.body: Chef Jessen supplies meat and provisions in Southshore, in the southern Hillsbrad Foothills, for locals and visiting Alliance soldiers. He is a skilled cook. Before plague and war disrupted northern Lordaeron, he often traveled north past Dalaran to the shores of Lordamere Lake. There he gathered meat from native snapjaw turtles to make his prized, hearty Soothing Turtle Bisque. He will share the recipe with travelers who help him gather its ingredients.

faq.answer: Chef Jessen is a human butcher and cook in Southshore, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He sells meat and shares local recipes with travelers who support the Alliance.

faq.q: What is Chef Jessen's famous dish?
faq.answer: Chef Jessen's signature dish is Soothing Turtle Bisque. In years past, he gathered fresh snapjaw turtle meat from around Lordamere Lake, north past Dalaran, to make the hearty broth.

faq.q: Why does Chef Jessen ask travelers for help?
faq.answer: Gathering snapjaw turtle meat around Lordamere Lake has grown dangerous because of regional instability and the nearby Forsaken presence. Chef Jessen relies on capable travelers to collect the meat for his bisque.

faq.q: Does Chef Jessen sell anything unusual?
faq.answer: Chef Jessen sells meat to the people of Southshore. His specialty is Soothing Turtle Bisque, a recipe he teaches cooks who help gather snapjaw meat.

angles.text: As a cook passing through Hillsbrad, you can turn to Jessen for his turtle bisque recipe, a substantial meal for hardy travelers.
In Southshore, Jessen helps feed Alliance soldiers and adventurers holding the defensive line against northern threats.
